findings.risk: client-supplied identity headers could bypass app roles without trusted proxy stripping
findings.compensating_control: require authenticated TLS reverse proxy, strip Mesh identity headers before upstream forwarding, and run scripts/verify_authenticated_ingress.py before staging exposure

findings.risk: run streams can disclose operational state if exposed outside authenticated ingress
findings.compensating_control: serve streams only behind the authenticated reverse proxy and require viewer-or-higher identity at the ingress boundary

findings.risk: untrusted vendor payloads can create noisy or forged alerts if source registration and signatures are bypassed
findings.compensating_control: use registered webhook sources with HMAC verification and vendor-specific template validation before enabling external webhook ingress

findings.risk: OTLP push receiver can accept untrusted metrics if enabled without bearer token or private ingress
findings.compensating_control: keep the receiver disabled by default and require MESH_OTEL_RECEIVER_TOKEN or private ingress before staging readiness passes

findings.risk: live Kubernetes credentials can mutate unintended namespaces without explicit allowlists
findings.compensating_control: live execution remains disabled unless context and namespace allowlists are configured and policy, evaluation, approval, and rollback gates pass

findings.risk: proposal agents could gain production actuator, kubeconfig, or repository-write authority
findings.compensating_control: connector certification blocks proposal-only lanes when runtime evidence indicates production actuator or repository-write credentials are present

findings.risk: state, memory, and Merkle proof loss would make operator audit incomplete
findings.compensating_control: staging readiness requires backup/restore rehearsal proof and pilot readiness requires Postgres-backed state

findings.risk: run export bundles can disclose secrets or outlive approved retention windows
findings.compensating_control: run export generation redacts secret-shaped fields, records retention metadata, requires retention review for pilot readiness, and has retrieval/upload verifiers

findings.risk: model lifecycle artifacts can be referenced locally without durable upload proof
findings.compensating_control: production readiness requires durable object-storage URI prefixes and upload proof for Mesh Brain artifacts before relying on model-lifecycle evidence
